description: We are AUB team from TED Çorum College and we are going to create a map of mars to support exploring the planet.
summary: We will make a map of planet Mars to build a base at Mars so humans can may live at Mars in the future.The map will include livable places of Mars intensively.
details:
Project summary

We built an interactive map of Mars that highlights the most suitable

locations for a human mission. It combines four criteria into a single

habitability score for every point on the planet: access to water ice,

low elevation, solar energy and temperature, and flat terrain. Users can

change the weight of each criterion to explore different priorities

(water, safety, energy) and compare eight candidate sites such as Arcadia

Planitia, Utopia Planitia, Jezero Crater and Gale Crater.

Key finding

Water ice is found at mid and high latitudes, while solar energy is

strongest near the equator, so the best site depends on how the criteria

are weighted. The northern plains are flat, low and close to ice,

which makes them balanced candidates.

Data and limitations

Elevation and slope are derived from an elevation map based on NASA Mars

Global Surveyor MOLA data. The water ice layer is currently a

latitude-based estimate and will be replaced with SWIM data. The map does

not yet include fine-scale terrain, radiation or detailed landing safety.

Interactive map: https://aquamarine-crepe-76cdd0.netlify.app

The map interface and code were developed with the help of an AI assistant

(Claude by Anthropic). The project direction, criteria and interpretation

are ours.
